consequence.statement: Monitoring systems, dashboards, and alerting rules that reference the metric lbipam_ips_used_total will no longer find the metric under its previous name, causing metric collection and alerts to fail or stop reporting.
consequence.remediation: Update all Prometheus scrape configurations, Grafana dashboards, alerting rules, and any monitoring queries to use the new metric name lbipam_ips_used instead of lbipam_ips_used_total.

original.statement: The Cilium metric lbipam_ips_used_total has been renamed to lbipam_ips_used.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, Cilium reports the metric as lbipam_ips_used instead of lbipam_ips_used_total. The upgrade notes list this under Changed Metrics and do not say that anything fails or is rejected.
consequence.remediation: Check dashboards, recording rules and alerts that reference lbipam_ips_used_total, and update them to lbipam_ips_used where needed.

corrected.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the LB-IPAM metric lbipam_ips_used_total is renamed to lbipam_ips_used. Cilium still reports it, but under the new name; anything that queries the old name should be reviewed.

decision.reason: [ev-1bf87d491deb] says only that the metric `lbipam_ips_used_total` has been renamed to `lbipam_ips_used`, listed under "Changed Metrics" with no stated failure. The surrounding section [ev-2e2ab2d37845] [ev-875bb56564b0] lists more renames of the same kind and also says nothing fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. setting-ignored does not fit: a metric Cilium emits is not a configured value Cilium stops honouring, and the claim that alerts and collection fail goes beyond the evidence. The evidence supports a review-class behavior-change: Cilium still reports the data, under a new name.
